self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Precise (R5): Increases DMG against weak spots by 48%. Only aimed shots (Charged Attacks) can target weak spots, and there is no weak-spot stat in the evaluator, so this is modelled as charged_dmg_. Enable it only when the board's aimed shots are assumed to hit weak spots. refinementStates carries R1/R3/R5 (R2/R4 read R1/R3); `states` stays the R5 tier.

en.flavor: This superior bow once belonged to a master archer. However, it gives off a strong scent, thus making it unsuitable for hunting.

refinements.5: Increases DMG against weak spots by <r>48%</r>.
